brief.request: Render a public-domain jazz-standard reference with baritone saxophone melody and the original piano accompaniment.
brief.creative_summary: The original eight-bar piano introduction leads into one complete 32-bar chorus in AABA form; the printed second ending is used without expanding the repeat.

arguments.title: Georgia on My Mind - Baritone Sax Reference

arguments.name: Baritone Saxophone
arguments.role: lead melody from the 1930 score, one octave lower

rationale: Transcribed from the University of South Florida Libraries 1930 score and MusicXML at https://digitalcommons.usf.edu/sheet_music_collection/47/. The source is marked No Copyright - United States. Source measures 1-8 form the introduction; measures 27-56 and 59-60 form one complete chorus with the second ending. The source vocal line is rendered instrumentally one octave lower on baritone saxophone; the piano pitches and rhythms are preserved.
